app.name: Genesis Plus GX
app.long_description:
Genesis Plus GX by Eke-Eke: Mega Drive / Genesis, Mega CD, Master System, Game Gear and SG-1000 emulator.
This build also reads Xbox 360 (XInput) USB controllers and 2.4 GHz receivers plugged into the Wii, as GameCube controllers. Mode + Right opens the menu.
